summary: Auto-generated self-service forms order fields as: a hidden OAuth token field (always present), then one AAPResourcePicker per enabled Prompt on Launch option (inventories, credentials, execution environments, resolved from names to IDs at launch), then survey questions with matching input types (text, dropdown, password, textarea, integer, float, multiplechoice, multiselect).
questions: In what order do fields appear in an auto-generated self-service template?
Is the OAuth token field visible in self-service forms?
Which survey question types does self-service automation portal support?
When are resource names resolved to IDs in self-service automation portal?

answer_card.title: Field order in auto-generated self-service templates
answer_card.answer_md:
1. **OAuth token** (always present, always hidden), auto-filled with the user's token.
2. **Prompt on Launch fields**: each becomes an `AAPResourcePicker`; users pick inventories, credentials or execution environments by name, resolved to IDs at launch.
3. **Survey questions**: each becomes a field of the matching type (`text`, `dropdown`, `password`, `textarea`, `integer`, `float`, `multiplechoice`, `multiselect`).
